title: spring.influxdb
description: Two buckets: spring.influxdb.default holds family-wide values (each overridable per instance), spring.influxdb.instances.<name> holds one entry per named instance. No other key belongs directly under spring.influxdb.

default.description: Family-wide values, each overridable by an instance.

driver.description: Names the Driver bean that assembles every instance's transport unless an instance names its own. Empty injects the single Driver bean by type; naming a missing bean fails startup.

instances.description: One entry per instance; the key is the bean name, and any name is legal.

org.description: default organization for the wrapper's write/query helpers

bucket.description: default destination bucket for the wrapper's write helpers
